programme.title: The Jesus Code
programme.desc: 'S2/E1 - Childhood Home Of Jesus'. Explore the uncovering of a 2,000-year-old house hidden under modern Nazareth, which experts believe could be the childhood home of Jesus.

programme.title: The Jesus Code
programme.desc: 'S2/E2 - The Tomb Of King Herod'. This episode looks at the Bible's most notorious villain, King Herod, and investigates whether his fearsome reputation is deserved.

programme.title: Lost Grail With Alice Roberts
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - In The Shadow Of The Tor'. Professor Alice Roberts begins her quest on Britain's windswept south coast, investigating the biblical legend of Joseph of Arimathea, a tale woven deep into English folklore.

programme.title: Gold Wars Downunder
programme.desc: 'S1/E7'. Donnie comes up with a brainwave idea to host a live on-line auction to sell off the gold he's found at Swiss Diggings. He'll use the money to part-fund the land deal he's been offered.

programme.title: Swamp People
programme.desc: 'S17/E4 - The 17-Gator Gauntlet'. Troy rallies the Landry fleet with a bold 17-gator quota per boat, pushing every team to the breaking point as dropping water levels raise the stakes.

programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
programme.desc: 'S2/E3 - Shady Secrets'. Some secrets refuse to stay buried. Whether it's illicit cargo in a frozen lake, a stolen masterpiece worth millions, or a brothel hidden in the shadow of the Capitol-the truth always resurfaces.

programme.title: The Unxplained With William Shatner
programme.desc: 'S7/E5 - Secrets Of The Civil War'. From 1861-1865, the United States of America found itself in a bloody four-year struggle known as the Civil War. From rumours of lost treasure, to mysterious premonitions...

programme.title: Battlefields
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Anglo Zulu War'. In 1879, soldiers of the British invasion force clashed with warriors of the Zulu Kingdom. The Zulu warriors overwhelmed the British, who suffered a devastating loss.

programme.title: Shipwrecks: When History Resurfaces
programme.desc: 'S2/E2 - The Last Hours Of Saint-Pierre'. In Martinique. Kevin discovers shipwrecks that are the last witnesses of the deadliest volcanic eruption of the 20th century.

programme.title: Holy Marvels With Dennis Quaid
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - Holy Riches'. The legendary treasures of the Copper Scroll, King Solomon's mines, and the Syamantaka Gem have captivated the world for centuries. But could these fortunes still be out there, waiting to be discovered?

programme.title: Holy Marvels With Dennis Quaid
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Hidden Wonders'. Most of the world's holiest places sit in plain sight. But there are some hidden deep underground. Why were they concealed? And what mysteries have we unearthed in these subterranean sacred spaces?

programme.title: Holy Marvels With Dennis Quaid
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Hidden Wonders'. Most of the world's holiest places sit in plain sight. But there are some hidden deep underground. Why were they concealed? And what mysteries have we unearthed in these subterranean sacred spaces?

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S9/E6 - Mo Money Mo Valley'. Lockers go for big bucks as the buyers hit auctions in Moreno Valley, CA. Ivy and Dave duke it out for a pair of units while Mary tries to avoid the shrapnel.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S9/E7 - Downtown Lockers And Uptown Dreams'. The buyers try to find a score in a tower of lockers in downtown LA. Plus, Darrell and Brandon are determined to get more merchandise for their 24/7 shop.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S9/E8 - Lock, Stock And One Smoking Darrel'. Brandi surprises Jarrod with a thick bankroll, while Darrell and Brandon win an auction that contains something that lands them in court.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S9/E9 - Rene Abides'. Ivy has high hopes despite a dismal past in the area, while Mary challenges Rene to a bet that has more than money at stake.

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S10/E15 - Beat The Judges: Tackling The Tizona'. Two of our top Forged in Fire champions head back into our arena. Tasked with making the legendary Tizona of El Cid in eight hours.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: 'S15/E10 - The Giants Of Malta'. Could the ancient mysteries that exist on the Mediterranean islands of Malta be connected to local legends of alien visitation and giant hybrid beings?

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: 'S15/E11 - The Top Ten Pyramid Sites'. Counting down the world's top ten pyramid sites, from a valley in Peru with over 250 hidden pyramids to an ancient Greek city with mysterious 4800-year-old ruins to Egypt's Giza Plateau.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: 'S15/E12 - The Top Ten Mysterious Devices'. Counting down the world's top ten mysterious devices, from strange, grooved disks found in a cave in China to an ancient Greek computer.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: 'S15/E13 - The Top Ten Mysterious Islands'. Counting down the world's top ten mysterious islands, including sites said to be home to giants and islands that disappear into thin air.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S9/E22 - Mary's Big Score'. Lockers in El Monte, California have been known to hold some great finds, and this auction is no different.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S9/E23 - Auctions Arriba!'. Having heard of the recent scores, Dave does not intend to let another great locker get by and Rene attempts some inside information.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S9/E24 - The One With Mary and Allee'. Jarrod and Brandi refuse to be fooled by the allure of showbiz treasures, but Mary and her new friend Allee are targeted on tinseltown.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S9/E26 - Father Bids Best'. Darrell and Brandon look to instigate the other buyers and sneak through the melee. Rene brings his father Gunter to the auction, resulting in laughs and profits.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S9/E27 - The Fat Lady Is Warming Up'. Jarrod and Brandi are looking for an easy ride and are unprepared for a marathon auction. Without Brandon to help out, Darrell must face the competition alone.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S9/E29 - Downtown Showdown'. An auction in LA brings more buyers than Dan and Laura bargained for. Ivy tries to keep the peace, but gets dragged into an auction.

programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.title: Mystery Places
programme.desc: 'S1/E17'. Explore Guantanamo, China's railway through buildings, and Washington, D.C.'s largest museum complex. Discover Poland's mysterious forest, the world's largest apartment building.

programme.title: Mystery Places
programme.desc: 'S1/E18'. Visit a remarkable South Korean prison, explore unusual islands worldwide, and discover Bangkok's Ghost Tower. Meet the strong men of Jakabol Gym and delve into Xinjiang's Chili harvest in China.

programme.title: Mystery Places
programme.desc: 'S1/E19'. Uncover the Hadzabe Myth in Tanzania, explore Colorado's Cheyenne Mountain Complex, and visit unique villages worldwide. Discover Croatia's abandoned boat and China's futuristic house in our intriguing journey.

programme.title: Mystery Places
programme.desc: 'S1/E20'. We go after the world's loneliest man, travel to the incredible Masdar City, and visit a house in the middle of a street. We also check out the incredible Wieliczka Salt Mine in Poland.

programme.title: Jesse James' Hidden Treasure
programme.desc: Jesse Woodson James, America's most notorious outlaw, robbed his way to over half-a-billion dollars. Officially, he died in 1882, but is there more to the story than it seems?

programme.title: Great Escapes With Morgan Freeman
programme.desc: 'S2/E4 - The Sobibor Revolt'. The Nazi war machine created specialized camps that were used for killing prisoners. At Sobibor, a group of Jews that were forced to keep the camp operational, engineered a mass escape.

programme.title: Great Escapes With Morgan Freeman
programme.desc: 'S2/E5 - Escaping Devil's Island'. Rene Belbenoit is sentenced to hard time at France's notorious penal colony in French Guiana. He determines to escape or die trying. After numerous harrowing escapes, he finally gets free.

programme.title: Great Escapes With Morgan Freeman
programme.desc: 'S2/E6 - Alton City Escape'. Quawntay Adams gets caught up in a large-scale marijuana bust. When he finds out he is going to be a father, he determines to break out of his maximum-security cell-which he does.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S16/E1 - The Return Of The Return Of San Burrito'. Back in San Bernardino, Kenny uses an old friend's tactics to land the right unit, Brandi muscles through a dusty locker, Ivy digs deeper, and Rene and Casey gamble on a room.
